summary: Tested all newly added features end-to-end: backend pytest for admin broadcast notifications, support tickets, payout details, wallet withdrawal + admin status flow, merchant balance/withdrawal; frontend Playwright coverage of customer login via phone OTP, Profile->merchant dashboard button, Settings bank save, Wallet withdraw (with auto-prefilled payout), Notifications page, Support ticket raise, Addresses save, Home store card images; admin login, Notifications send + history, Support Tickets reply + mark resolved, Withdrawals list showing bank details. All 5 backend tests pass; all frontend data-testid elements present and flows succeed.
critical_code_review_comments: payout schema uses 'bank_account' (not 'account_number'); keep naming consistent across API docs/UI data-testid 'payout-account-number' maps to bank_account field - fine but worth documenting.
GET /api/notifications returns {notifications,unread_count} while admin broadcast /api/admin/notifications returns a different shape - acceptable but tests must handle both.
/api/wallet/withdrawals response returns {success, withdrawal_id, balance} with no explicit 'status' field; UI relies on toast + wallet balance change which works.

Address save page sets 'Kerala, 673001' as default state/pincode automatically which may surprise users entering an address outside Kerala; consider inferring state/pincode from input or making them editable visibly.
Admin ticket modal lacks data-testid on reply status buttons for Open/In Progress/Closed (only resolved has ticket-set-resolved); for consistent testability, add testids for all status transitions.
